response.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length > 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY (avg_length IS NULL), avg_length DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "More than 112 minutes" is a strict comparison (length > 112), so films of exactly 112 minutes are excluded. The WHERE clause also drops films with NULL length.
"Language" means film.language_id, not original_language_id, as the request names.

AVG skips NULL replacement_cost values, and a group whose averages are all NULL returns NULL. The ORDER BY puts NULL averages last. Rows with equal average running time have no guaranteed order because no tie-breaker was specified.
